artifacts.delta_brief: Between 2023 and 2024, WM continues to emphasize demand as core risk exposure (2023 para 33; 2024 para 10). The earlier filing is relatively more anchored in demand, while the later filing adds clearer weight to demand (2023 para 62; 2024 para 8). Across both years, management frames these items as operational and financial execution pressures rather than isolated one-off events (2023 para 33; 2024 para 8). This comparison should be read as directional because the lens is a focuspack subset and not the full Item 1A text (2023 para 62; 2024 para 10). Overall, the narrative indicates continuity with selective shifts in emphasis instead of a full thematic reset (2023 para 33; 2024 para 10).
